Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: P0-04 direction A concept board for an original top-down 3D arcade city sandbox, reference art only.
Primary request: Make a polished landscape board titled "A — SUNFADED CIVIC". Upper two-thirds is a convincing gameplay-camera concept painting of a quiet, funny small urban district. Steep overhead camera about 65 degrees below horizontal, fixed north-up yaw, no horizon, only short south-facing wall strips visible, broad flat roofs. A four-way road junction, continuous cream sidewalks, a small plaza at upper right with a squat municipal water tower capped by a scalloped circular roof, a car repair yard lower right, warm peach and butter-yellow low-rise shops upper left, muted teal warehouse lower left. Dry fixed midday light, short crisp shadows to southeast. Wide muted dark slate asphalt. Roads stay visually quiet.
Subject: One clear player near centre sidewalk wearing a cream jacket and dark trousers, a coral compact hatchback with short wheelbase and near-square roof, a mustard long boxy sedan with distinctly longer bonnet and trunk, four sparse pedestrians. One small orange/cream explosive burst far from player. Plausible scale: people 1.8 metres tall, cars 4 to 4.6 metres long, ordinary buildings 5 to 8 metres tall; sidewalks 4 metres wide, two-way roads 9 metres wide. Gameplay is the priority, no dense clutter. Original civic humor on one sign: "BUREAU OF SMALL PROBLEMS". No HUD.
Style/medium: chunky clean beveled low-poly forms, flat color blocks, simple broad rooftop silhouettes, toy-like construction without miniature tilt-shift or depth of field. Muted sand, peach, cream, dusty teal world palette; brighter coral, cream-yellow and cyan are reserved for actors and momentary feedback.
Lower one-third: compact clean reference strip on off-white paper, split into "SILHOUETTES" and "VFX". Show solid charcoal top-view silhouettes of squat shop, sawtooth warehouse, round-capped landmark; compact hatchback vs long sedan; walking person; pistol, SMG, long rocket launcher. Then three labelled explosive keyframes "FLASH", "BURST", "CLEAR" with small off-white core, orange lobes and dispersing slate smoke. Crisp readable labels, restrained typography.
Constraints: original designs; no existing franchise assets, police, missions, city skyline, realistic textures, bloom haze, rainy reflections, grunge, overhead utility wires, interiors, modeled people inside cars, excessive smoke or tall props obscuring player. This is conceptual reference, not a screenshot or validated camera.
